title: Validate and cap the ?limit= query parameter

source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: A client sent ?limit=100000 and the catalog endpoint returned 100k rows, timing out the database. Validate and cap the limit parameter.
constraints: Valid existing requests (limit 1..100) must behave exactly as before.
Invalid values must not produce an error response (clients rely on the default).
input.context: Catalog API (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types). parseLimit() is used by all list endpoints; documented maximum is 100.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: suggesting a schema validation library, returning HTTP 400 instead of the default (excluded by the constraint), or making the max configurable.
